name: Founder & Press Kit
tagline: Editorial portraits for features, funding news and About pages.
description: The photos journalists ask for when your startup makes the news. Magazine-feature portraits in loft offices, workshops and launch stages, plus clean press-kit shots with room to crop. Smart casual founder style, honest light and no cheesy stock-photo poses.
